Players Committee card image of [[Seventh Sister]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Attrition against you is -1 here while with a Jedi, Padawan, probe droid, or 'Hatred' card. Once per turn, may use 1 Force (free if your probe droid here) to draw top card of Reserve Deck. Your Inquisitors and probe droids here are immune to attrition < 4.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Seventh%20Sister.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Seventh Sister.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
